I actually find it surprisingly difficult to treat my son and daughter exactly the same. If my daughter says, “Dad, can you bring me some ice water?” my instinct is, Of course, and I go get it for her.

If my son asks me the exact same thing, my first instinct is, No. Get up and get it yourself. My wife and I have actually argued about this whether that extra harshness I feel toward him is something I should consciously correct, or whether there’s some useful evolutionary instinct buried in it. A father feeling compelled to make his son a little tougher than he would his daughter.

But for the most part, they don't close deals yet.

This will change, outside field sales and complex enterprise sales.

candidates.text:
it definitely sucks right now. i did help get the message roll out on behalf of my friends for the said event when it was presented as an "outside operating hours" set up about the infrastructure of the hospital feeling less clinical..

this entire thing saddens me because i know it may feel like i have no empathy.. so i’m sorry that an idea which floated around with no malice in anyone’s heart has reminded people of terribly troubling days in their lives. i had my apprehension but with eventual near-peer communication, i couldn’t get myself through. but now in hindsight, i knew it was so evident from the get-go.

personally,
> i deleted the tweet a couple of days back. should’ve been sooner.
> i wasn’t there at the event because how i process the whole thing now is at such odds with what i felt when this was just an idea (not like i’m here to lecture anyone on moral compasses)
> despite multiple efforts, the event did happen, which was completely out of my control…

which is what sucks the most... cuz plenty posts & people have confused me as the organiser and the source of the idea itself. and for sanity, there was no money involved for the promotion and more of a lack of judgement while showing up for friends (which i should be looking at more seriously and trust my gut going forward)

for someone who has got the best of her life off this platform, i feel terrible & i know i'll do better.

PS: i guess the threats die in a few.. right?
